title: Cao Cao Pacifies the North; Guo Jia Wins a Campaign after His Own Death
summary: The last Yuan brothers flee to Liaodong. Cao Cao does not pursue: on the advice Guo Jia left behind him, sealed, he simply halts and waits — and Gongsun Kang, calculating that two guests are more dangerous than one enemy, sends their heads down instead.
Guo Jia dies on the road home at thirty-seven. Cao Cao mourns him harder than he mourned his own son.
history: The posthumous stratagem is historical, and so is Cao Cao's grief. He would say after Red Cliffs that if Guo Jia had lived it would not have happened.

pins.note: Halts, and lets the frontier do his killing.
Dies at thirty-seven, having won one more campaign in a sealed letter.
